rapport_notes: Warm and responsive; handles the moving-blanket-deposit explanation clearly and answers the customer's follow-up 'what if I add 3 boxes' question thoughtfully rather than brushing it off.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before I discuss the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any concern about the moving process" — asked only after all logistics were confirmed; customer said 'Nope, no'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concern was raised when finally asked
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if ever the move takes less than this, he will only be charged for how much time we use"

top_strength: Explicit close: "should I confirm now your reservation for September 22nd Tuesday?" — a real ask rather than just emailing a quote and hoping.
coaching_note: No damage coverage or Meet Your Mover mention despite a 70-inch TV and a storage-unit drop-off — exactly the kind of move where 'we move it like it's ours' reassurance earns its keep.
